title: 原子干涉重力儀~Atomic-interferometer gravimeters
focus: 拉曼脈衝原子干涉、k_eff·g·T² 相位與微伽等級的絕對重力量測工程~Raman-pulse atom interferometry, the k_eff·g·T² phase and microgal-level absolute-gravity engineering
summary: 以銣-87 自由落體原子干涉重力儀為對象，從 π/2–π–π/2 拉曼脈衝序列與相位 Δφ = k_eff·g·T² 出發，建置啁啾讀出、雷射與真空系統、反射鏡隔振與傾斜控制，再以 k 向量反轉、科氏力與潮汐校正建立誤差預算，最後透過古典加速度計混合與落體式重力儀比對完成微伽等級的驗收。~Taking a rubidium-87 free-fall atom-interferometer gravimeter as the object, this course starts from the π/2–π–π/2 Raman pulse sequence and the phase Δφ = k_eff·g·T², builds the chirp readout, laser and vacuum systems, mirror vibration isolation and tilt control, establishes an error budget through k-vector reversal, Coriolis and tidal corrections, and closes with classical-accelerometer hybridization and comparison against a free-fall gravimeter for microgal-level acceptance.

units.anchor: π/2–π–π/2 拉曼脈衝序列~The π/2–π–π/2 Raman pulse sequence
units.title: 物質波馬赫—曾德干涉與重力相位~Matter-wave Mach–Zehnder interferometry and the gravity phase
units.mechanism: 一團冷銣原子在真空中自由落下，三個相隔 T 的雙光子拉曼脈衝扮演物質波的分束器、反射鏡與合束器：第一個 π/2 脈衝把原子分成兩條動量相差 ħk_eff 的路徑，π 脈衝交換兩路，最後的 π/2 脈衝讓它們干涉，干涉結果表現為兩個超精細基態的布居比例。每次脈衝都把雷射相位印在原子上，而雷射相位隨原子位置變化，於是兩條路徑的相位差正比於原子在三個時刻的位置，即 Δφ = k_eff·g·T²。重力儀的「尺」是雷射波長、「鐘」是 T，兩者都可溯源到原子或頻率標準，所以量測是絕對的。~A cloud of cold rubidium atoms falls freely in vacuum while three two-photon Raman pulses separated by T act as beam splitter, mirror and recombiner for the matter wave: the first π/2 pulse splits the atoms into two paths differing in momentum by ħk_eff, the π pulse swaps them, and the final π/2 pulse makes them interfere, the outcome appearing as the population ratio of the two hyperfine ground states. Each pulse imprints the laser phase on the atoms, and that phase varies with atom position, so the path phase difference is proportional to the atom positions at the three instants, Δφ = k_eff·g·T². The gravimeter's ruler is the laser wavelength and its clock is T, both traceable to atomic or frequency standards, which makes the measurement absolute.
units.model: 銣-87 D2 線 λ = 780.24 nm，反向傳播拉曼光束的 k_eff = 2×2π/λ = 1.611×10⁷ rad/m；取 T = 100 ms，比例因子 k_eff·T² = 1.611×10⁵ rad/(m/s²)，g = 9.81 m/s² 的干涉相位 Δφ = 1.58×10⁶ rad。若每次量測的相位雜訊為 10 mrad，單次重力解析度 δg = 0.010/1.611×10⁵ = 6.2×10⁻⁸ m/s² = 6.2 µGal（1 µGal = 10⁻⁸ m/s²，約為 g 的 10⁻⁹）。~For the rubidium-87 D2 line λ = 780.24 nm, counter-propagating Raman beams give k_eff = 2×2π/λ = 1.611×10⁷ rad/m; with T = 100 ms the scale factor is k_eff·T² = 1.611×10⁵ rad/(m/s²), and g = 9.81 m/s² produces an interferometer phase Δφ = 1.58×10⁶ rad. With 10 mrad of phase noise per shot the single-shot gravity resolution is δg = 0.010/1.611×10⁵ = 6.2×10⁻⁸ m/s² = 6.2 µGal (1 µGal = 10⁻⁸ m/s², about 10⁻⁹ of g).
units.verify: 以 T = 10、20、40、80 ms 分別掃描第三個脈衝的相位並記錄干涉條紋，確認條紋週期固定而相位隨 T² 增加；把 T 加倍時條紋相位應增加四倍，偏離 T² 律表示脈衝時序或拉曼光相位有系統誤差。同時記錄條紋對比，T = 100 ms 時應仍有 30% 以上。~Scan the phase of the third pulse at T = 10, 20, 40 and 80 ms and record the fringes, confirming a constant fringe period with phase growing as T²; doubling T should quadruple the phase, and any departure from the T² law indicates a systematic error in pulse timing or Raman phase. Record fringe contrast at the same time, which should remain above 30% at T = 100 ms.
units.failure: 拉曼光束未真正反向傳播（同向傳播的拉曼躍遷），k_eff 退化為兩束的波向量差而近乎為零，原子對重力幾乎不敏感，儀器輸出看似穩定卻與 g 無關。~If the Raman beams are not truly counter-propagating (co-propagating Raman transition), k_eff collapses to the near-zero difference of the two wavevectors, the atoms become almost insensitive to gravity, and the output looks stable but has nothing to do with g.
units.misconception: 原子干涉重力儀是量原子落下的時間，和落體式重力儀原理相同。~An atom gravimeter times the atoms' fall, the same principle as a free-fall corner-cube gravimeter.

units.anchor: 拉曼頻率啁啾 α 與條紋讀出~Raman frequency chirp α and fringe readout
units.title: 都卜勒補償啁啾與 g 的讀出~Doppler-compensating chirp and the readout of g
units.mechanism: 原子落下時相對於拉曼光的都卜勒頻移以 k_eff·g/(2π) 的速率線性增加，若雙光子頻率差不跟著變，三個脈衝就會相繼失諧。因此兩束拉曼光的頻率差以速率 α 線性啁啾，總相位變為 Δφ = (k_eff·g − 2πα)·T²。掃描 α 並在不同 T 下記錄條紋，所有 T 的條紋在 α₀ = k_eff·g/(2π) 處交於同一點，此點與 T 無關，直接給出 g = 2πα₀/k_eff；這個「中心條紋」法把重力量測變成頻率量測，準確度取決於產生啁啾的直接數位合成器所用的參考振盪器。~As the atoms fall, their Doppler shift relative to the Raman light grows linearly at k_eff·g/(2π), and unless the two-photon frequency difference follows, the three pulses go progressively off resonance. The Raman frequency difference is therefore chirped linearly at rate α, and the total phase becomes Δφ = (k_eff·g − 2πα)·T². Scanning α and recording fringes at several T, all fringes cross at one point α₀ = k_eff·g/(2π) that is independent of T, giving g = 2πα₀/k_eff directly; this central-fringe method turns a gravity measurement into a frequency measurement whose accuracy rests on the reference oscillator feeding the direct digital synthesizer that produces the chirp.
units.model: α₀ = k_eff·g/(2π) = 1.611×10⁷×9.81/(2π) = 25.15 MHz/s。啁啾速率誤差 1 Hz/s 對應 δg = 2π×1/k_eff = 3.9×10⁻⁷ m/s² = 39 µGal；若參考振盪器的相對準確度為 1×10⁻⁹（GPS 馴服的銣鐘），δα = 0.025 Hz/s，δg ≈ 1 µGal。所以頻率參考的相對不確定度就是重力的相對不確定度：10⁻⁹ 的鐘給 10⁻⁹ g。~α₀ = k_eff·g/(2π) = 1.611×10⁷×9.81/(2π) = 25.15 MHz/s. A 1 Hz/s error in chirp rate corresponds to δg = 2π×1/k_eff = 3.9×10⁻⁷ m/s² = 39 µGal; with a reference oscillator of 1×10⁻⁹ fractional accuracy (a GPS-disciplined rubidium clock), δα = 0.025 Hz/s and δg ≈ 1 µGal. The fractional uncertainty of the frequency reference is thus the fractional uncertainty of gravity: a 10⁻⁹ clock gives 10⁻⁹ g.
units.verify: 在 T = 40、60、80、100 ms 下各掃描 α 跨越三個條紋週期，用正弦擬合找出每個 T 的條紋中心，確認四條曲線交於同一 α₀，交點離散應小於 0.05 Hz/s（約 2 µGal）；以頻率計數器對照 GPS 馴服鐘驗證合成器的輸出頻率與啁啾斜率，誤差應低於 10⁻⁹。~At T = 40, 60, 80 and 100 ms scan α across three fringe periods, locate each fringe centre by sine fitting and confirm that the four curves cross at one α₀ with a scatter below 0.05 Hz/s (about 2 µGal); verify the synthesizer's output frequency and chirp slope against a GPS-disciplined clock with a frequency counter, with error below 10⁻⁹.
units.failure: 合成器的時鐘用的是普通石英振盪器（10⁻⁶ 等級），啁啾速率隨溫度漂移 25 Hz/s，重力讀值每天擺動近 1 mGal，比地球潮汐大一個數量級。~Clocking the synthesizer from an ordinary quartz oscillator (10⁻⁶ class) lets the chirp rate drift by 25 Hz/s with temperature, and the gravity reading swings by nearly 1 mGal per day, an order of magnitude more than Earth tides.
units.misconception: 啁啾只是為了讓原子保持共振，對 g 的數值本身沒有影響。~The chirp merely keeps the atoms resonant and has no influence on the value of g.

units.anchor: 780 nm 拉曼雷射與 6.834 GHz 鎖相~780 nm Raman lasers with the 6.834 GHz phase lock
units.title: 雷射、真空與偵測次系統~Laser, vacuum and detection subsystems
units.mechanism: 雷射系統要提供冷卻光（鎖在 D2 線 F = 2→3' 附近）、回泵光（F = 1→2'）與兩束相位鎖定、頻率相差銣-87 超精細分裂 6.834 GHz 的拉曼光；拉曼光對激發態失諧約 1 GHz，以避免自發輻射。它們常由 1560 nm 光纖雷射倍頻或 780 nm 二極體雷射放大產生，並以飽和吸收穩頻。真空腔是鈦合金或玻璃腔，2D 磁光阱以高通量送原子進 3D 磁光阱，每 0.5 s 裝載約 10⁸ 個原子後釋放約 10⁵–10⁶ 個進入干涉；偵測在落體底部以共振螢光分別讀出 F = 1 與 F = 2 的原子數，取比值得到躍遷機率。~The laser system must provide cooling light (locked near the D2 F = 2→3' line), repump light (F = 1→2') and two phase-locked Raman beams whose frequencies differ by the rubidium-87 hyperfine splitting of 6.834 GHz, detuned about 1 GHz from the excited state to avoid spontaneous emission. They are typically produced by frequency-doubling 1560 nm fibre lasers or by amplified 780 nm diode lasers, and stabilised by saturated absorption. The vacuum chamber is a titanium-alloy or glass cell; a 2D MOT feeds a 3D MOT at high flux, loading about 10⁸ atoms every 0.5 s and releasing 10⁵–10⁶ into the interferometer; detection at the bottom of the fall reads the F = 1 and F = 2 populations by resonant fluorescence and takes their ratio as the transition probability.
units.model: 雙光子拉比頻率 Ω_eff = Ω₁Ω₂/(2Δ)。取單光子失諧 Δ = 2π×1 GHz、Ω₁ = Ω₂ = 2π×10 MHz，Ω_eff = 2π×50 kHz，π 脈衝長度 π/Ω_eff = 10 µs。所需強度由 Ω₁ = Γ√(I/(2I_sat)) 反推（Γ = 2π×6.07 MHz、I_sat = 1.67 mW/cm²）：I = 2I_sat(Ω₁/Γ)² = 2×1.67×(10/6.07)² = 9.1 mW/cm²；直徑 30 mm 的光束（7.07 cm²）每束需約 64 mW。~The two-photon Rabi frequency is Ω_eff = Ω₁Ω₂/(2Δ). With a single-photon detuning Δ = 2π×1 GHz and Ω₁ = Ω₂ = 2π×10 MHz, Ω_eff = 2π×50 kHz and a π pulse lasts π/Ω_eff = 10 µs. The required intensity follows from Ω₁ = Γ√(I/(2I_sat)) (Γ = 2π×6.07 MHz, I_sat = 1.67 mW/cm²): I = 2I_sat(Ω₁/Γ)² = 2×1.67×(10/6.07)² = 9.1 mW/cm²; a 30 mm diameter beam (7.07 cm²) needs about 64 mW per Raman beam.
units.verify: 以頻譜分析儀觀察兩束拉曼光的 6.834 GHz 拍頻，確認鎖相後載波內的功率比例高於 90%、鎖相迴路頻寬約 1 MHz；用拉比振盪實驗（改變脈衝長度記錄躍遷機率）量出 Ω_eff，確認 π 脈衝約 10 µs 且 π 脈衝效率高於 90%；以飛行時間法確認原子溫度約 2–3 µK。~Observe the 6.834 GHz beat between the two Raman beams on a spectrum analyser, confirming more than 90% of the power within the carrier after locking and a lock bandwidth of about 1 MHz; measure Ω_eff with a Rabi-oscillation experiment (transition probability versus pulse length), confirming a π pulse of about 10 µs with efficiency above 90%; confirm an atom temperature of 2–3 µK by time of flight.
units.failure: 拉曼光的單光子失諧只有 200 MHz，自發輻射在三個脈衝中讓 10% 的原子跳出干涉路徑，條紋對比掉到 15%，每次量測的相位雜訊加倍，且產生與功率相關的光位移。~A single-photon Raman detuning of only 200 MHz lets spontaneous emission knock 10% of the atoms out of the interferometer paths during the three pulses, contrast falls to 15%, the per-shot phase noise doubles and a power-dependent light shift appears.
units.misconception: 拉曼光的功率越高越好，因為脈衝越短對比越高。~More Raman power is always better because shorter pulses give higher contrast.

units.anchor: 拉曼反射鏡、隔振平台與傾斜~Raman mirror, isolation platform and tilt
units.title: 慣性參考鏡的機械設計與傾斜控制~Mechanical design of the inertial reference mirror and tilt control
units.mechanism: 原子感受到的雷射相位是由把拉曼光反射回來的那面鏡子定義的，因此那面鏡子才是重力儀的慣性參考：鏡子的任何加速度都與 g 無法區分，鏡子的傾斜則使量到的是 g 在光束方向的投影。工程上把鏡子放在被動（彈簧—質量，約 0.5 Hz）或主動（地震計回授）隔振平台上，並用傾斜計把拉曼光束對準鉛垂線；鏡面本身的平整度與拉曼光的波前像差也會轉成相位，因為原子雲在三個脈衝時看到光束的不同區域。~The laser phase the atoms feel is defined by the mirror that retro-reflects the Raman light, so that mirror is the gravimeter's inertial reference: any acceleration of the mirror is indistinguishable from g, and any tilt makes the measurement the projection of g onto the beam direction. Engineering places the mirror on a passive (spring–mass, about 0.5 Hz) or active (seismometer-feedback) isolation platform and aligns the Raman beam to the local vertical with tiltmeters; the mirror's flatness and the wavefront aberration of the Raman beam also turn into phase, because the cloud samples different regions of the beam at the three pulses.
units.model: 傾斜角 θ 時量到 g·cosθ，誤差 ≈ g·θ²/2：θ = 1 mrad 給 9.81×5×10⁻⁷ = 4.9×10⁻⁶ m/s² = 490 µGal；要把此項壓到 1.2 µGal，θ 必須 < 50 µrad（9.81×1.25×10⁻⁹ = 1.2×10⁻⁸ m/s²）。這相當於 1 m 長度上 50 µm 的高差，所以傾斜計解析度需達 10 µrad，且每次搬動後都要重新調垂。~With a tilt θ the measurement is g·cosθ and the error is ≈ g·θ²/2: θ = 1 mrad gives 9.81×5×10⁻⁷ = 4.9×10⁻⁶ m/s² = 490 µGal; keeping this term at 1.2 µGal requires θ < 50 µrad (9.81×1.25×10⁻⁹ = 1.2×10⁻⁸ m/s²). That is a 50 µm height difference over 1 m, so the tiltmeters need 10 µrad resolution and the vertical must be re-established after every relocation.
units.verify: 刻意把平台在兩個正交方向各傾斜 ±0.5、±1 mrad 並量 g，擬合拋物線 g(θ) = g₀·(1 − θ²/2)，拋物線頂點給出真正的鉛垂方向與傾斜計的零點偏置；以剪切干涉儀或夏克—哈特曼感測器量拉曼光束波前，要求 30 mm 口徑內像差低於 λ/20。~Deliberately tilt the platform by ±0.5 and ±1 mrad along two orthogonal axes and measure g, fit the parabola g(θ) = g₀·(1 − θ²/2), whose vertex gives the true vertical and the tiltmeter zero offsets; measure the Raman beam wavefront with a shearing interferometer or Shack–Hartmann sensor, requiring aberration below λ/20 over the 30 mm aperture.
units.failure: 隔振平台的共振頻率設在 2 Hz 而非 0.5 Hz，剛好落在干涉儀最敏感的 1–5 Hz 頻帶，地面微震被放大而不是衰減，每次量測的相位雜訊從 10 mrad 升到 300 mrad。~An isolation platform resonating at 2 Hz instead of 0.5 Hz sits right in the interferometer's most sensitive 1–5 Hz band, amplifies rather than attenuates ground microseisms, and the per-shot phase noise rises from 10 mrad to 300 mrad.
units.misconception: 原子在真空中自由落下，所以外界振動對原子干涉重力儀沒有影響。~Because the atoms fall freely in vacuum, external vibration cannot affect an atom gravimeter.

units.anchor: k 向量反轉、科氏力與潮汐~k-vector reversal, Coriolis and tides
units.title: 系統效應的量測、反轉與修正~Measuring, reversing and correcting systematic effects
units.mechanism: 許多系統相位與 k_eff 的方向無關（交流史塔克光位移、二階季曼位移、射頻相位），而重力相位會隨 k_eff 反號；交替使用 +k_eff 與 −k_eff 兩組拉曼躍遷並取差，就能消去這類項。與方向有關的則需個別評估：地球自轉的科氏力把原子雲的水平速度轉成垂直假加速度；地球潮汐讓 g 以半日週期變化上百微伽，必須用潮汐模型修正或作為儀器正確性的檢驗；大氣壓力與極移也各有 µGal 級貢獻。這些修正讓重力儀從「穩定」走向「準確」。~Many systematic phases are independent of the direction of k_eff (AC Stark light shifts, second-order Zeeman shift, RF phases) while the gravity phase changes sign with k_eff; alternating +k_eff and −k_eff Raman transitions and taking the difference cancels such terms. Direction-dependent effects must be evaluated individually: the Coriolis force from Earth's rotation converts the cloud's horizontal velocity into a false vertical acceleration; Earth tides change g by more than a hundred microgals with a semidiurnal period and must be corrected with a tidal model or used as a check of the instrument; atmospheric pressure and polar motion each contribute at the microgal level too. These corrections move the gravimeter from stable to accurate.
units.model: 科氏加速度 a_C = 2Ω_E·v_⊥，Ω_E = 7.29×10⁻⁵ rad/s：原子雲水平速度 v_⊥ = 1 mm/s 時 a_C = 2×7.29×10⁻⁵×10⁻³ = 1.46×10⁻⁷ m/s² = 14.6 µGal，2 mm/s 時 29 µGal，遠大於目標準確度，所以要用反射鏡的微旋轉（以地球自轉速率反向轉動鏡面）或東西向速度選擇來補償。固體潮汐的峰對峰幅度可達 200–300 µGal，重力儀必須能在 24 小時內以 µGal 級殘差重現潮汐曲線。~The Coriolis acceleration is a_C = 2Ω_E·v_⊥ with Ω_E = 7.29×10⁻⁵ rad/s: a cloud horizontal velocity v_⊥ = 1 mm/s gives a_C = 2×7.29×10⁻⁵×10⁻³ = 1.46×10⁻⁷ m/s² = 14.6 µGal, and 2 mm/s gives 29 µGal, far above the target accuracy, so it is compensated by counter-rotating the mirror at Earth's rotation rate or by east–west velocity selection. Solid-Earth tides reach 200–300 µGal peak to peak, and the gravimeter must reproduce the tidal curve over 24 hours with microgal-level residuals.
units.verify: 連續 48 小時以 ±k_eff 交替量測，把平均值減去潮汐模型（含海洋負荷）與氣壓修正後畫殘差，殘差標準差應在數 µGal 內且無半日週期殘留；把原子雲的水平速度刻意改變 ±1 mm/s（調整磁光阱釋放時的光功率平衡），量 g 的變化並與 2Ω_E·v_⊥ 比較，確認科氏補償有效。~Measure continuously for 48 hours alternating ±k_eff, subtract the tidal model (with ocean loading) and the pressure correction from the mean and plot the residual, whose standard deviation should be within a few microgals with no semidiurnal remnant; deliberately change the cloud's horizontal velocity by ±1 mm/s (by unbalancing MOT release power), measure the change in g and compare with 2Ω_E·v_⊥ to confirm that the Coriolis compensation works.
units.failure: 只用單一 k_eff 方向量測，拉曼光功率隨溫度變化使交流史塔克位移漂移，重力讀值出現 20 µGal 的日變化，被誤判為地下水位變動。~Measuring with a single k_eff direction lets the AC Stark shift drift as Raman power follows temperature, the gravity reading shows a 20 µGal daily variation, and it is misread as groundwater-level change.
units.misconception: 絕對重力儀不需要任何修正，因為它直接量 g。~An absolute gravimeter needs no corrections because it measures g directly.

units.anchor: 每次量測雜訊預算與系統偏差表~Per-shot noise budget and systematic-bias table
units.title: 靈敏度、雜訊預算與準確度預算~Sensitivity, noise budget and accuracy budget
units.mechanism: 重力儀有兩張預算表。靈敏度表列出每次量測的相位雜訊來源：量子投影雜訊（由原子數與條紋對比決定）、殘餘振動、偵測雜訊、拉曼雷射相位雜訊；合成後除以比例因子得到每次量測的 µGal 數，再除以重複率的平方根得到每 √Hz 的靈敏度，最後隨 √τ 平均。準確度表列出不隨平均縮小的偏差：科氏、波前像差、雙光子光位移、二階季曼、傾斜、儀器自重力與參考高度修正；每項以估計值加不確定度列出，均方根合成即儀器的準確度。兩張表分開看，才不會把「穩定」誤當「準確」。~A gravimeter carries two budget tables. The sensitivity table lists per-shot phase-noise sources: quantum projection noise (set by atom number and fringe contrast), residual vibration, detection noise and Raman-laser phase noise; their combination divided by the scale factor gives microgals per shot, dividing by the square root of the repetition rate gives the sensitivity per √Hz, and the result averages down as √τ. The accuracy table lists biases that do not average away: Coriolis, wavefront aberration, two-photon light shift, second-order Zeeman, tilt, instrument self-gravity and the reference-height correction; each is listed as an estimate with an uncertainty, and their root-sum-square is the instrument's accuracy. Keeping the tables separate prevents mistaking stable for accurate.
units.model: 量子投影雜訊 δφ = 1/(C√N)，C = 0.5、N = 10⁵ 時 6.3 mrad = 3.9 µGal；殘餘振動（混合修正後）10 µGal、偵測 3 µGal，每次量測合成 √(4² + 10² + 3²) = 11.2 µGal；重複率 2 Hz 給 11.2×√0.5 = 7.9 µGal/√Hz，平均 1000 s 後 0.25 µGal。準確度表（教學假設）：科氏 0.5、波前 1.5、雙光子光位移 0.5、季曼 0.3、傾斜 0.3、自重力 0.5 µGal，合成 √(0.25 + 2.25 + 0.25 + 0.09 + 0.09 + 0.25) = 1.8 µGal。~Quantum projection noise δφ = 1/(C√N) with C = 0.5 and N = 10⁵ is 6.3 mrad = 3.9 µGal; residual vibration (after hybrid correction) 10 µGal and detection 3 µGal combine to √(4² + 10² + 3²) = 11.2 µGal per shot; at 2 Hz repetition that is 11.2×√0.5 = 7.9 µGal/√Hz, averaging to 0.25 µGal after 1000 s. Accuracy table (teaching assumptions): Coriolis 0.5, wavefront 1.5, two-photon light shift 0.5, Zeeman 0.3, tilt 0.3, self-gravity 0.5 µGal, combining to √(0.25 + 2.25 + 0.25 + 0.09 + 0.09 + 0.25) = 1.8 µGal.
units.verify: 記錄連續 10⁴ 次量測並計算艾倫偏差，確認斜率 −1/2 且 1 s 的值與預算表的 7.9 µGal/√Hz 一致；在深夜地面安靜時段重做，若雜訊下降則振動項仍為主導；把原子數減半，確認雜訊只小幅上升，證明量子投影雜訊不是瓶頸。對準確度表，逐項以參數反轉（±k、±磁場、拉曼功率加倍）量出係數並更新。~Record 10⁴ consecutive shots and compute the Allan deviation, confirming a −1/2 slope and a 1 s value matching the budget's 7.9 µGal/√Hz; repeat during quiet night hours, and if the noise drops the vibration term still dominates; halve the atom number and confirm only a small noise increase, proving that quantum projection noise is not the bottleneck. For the accuracy table, measure each coefficient by parameter reversal (±k, ±magnetic field, doubled Raman power) and update it.
units.failure: 把波前像差項憑經驗填 0.2 µGal 而未實際量測光束，實際光束因準直透鏡應力有 λ/8 的像散，造成約 6 µGal 的偏差，與落體式重力儀比對時整台儀器系統性偏高。~Entering 0.2 µGal for the wavefront term from experience without measuring the beam, while the real beam carries λ/8 of astigmatism from a stressed collimating lens, leaves a bias of about 6 µGal and the whole instrument reads systematically high against a free-fall gravimeter.
units.misconception: 平均時間夠長，所有誤差都會被平均掉。~Given enough averaging time, every error averages away.

units.anchor: 古典加速度計混合與序列時序~Classical-accelerometer hybridization and sequence timing
units.title: 系統整合：振動混合修正、時序與可運輸性~System integration: hybrid vibration correction, timing and transportability
units.mechanism: 原子干涉儀對反射鏡加速度的響應由靈敏度函數描述：在 0 到 1/(2T) 附近最敏感，更高頻率被平均掉。整合時在反射鏡上安裝低雜訊古典加速度計，記錄每次量測期間的加速度 a(t)，以靈敏度函數加權積分得到振動引起的相位，再從干涉相位中扣除或用來即時選擇讀出條紋；這種混合法把隔振平台的需求降低一個數量級，並讓儀器能在沒有安靜地基的野外工作。時序控制器以微秒精度排程裝載、釋放、三個脈衝與偵測，並把所有類比訊號同步記錄，以便事後追溯任何一次量測的狀態。~An atom interferometer's response to mirror acceleration is described by a sensitivity function that peaks from 0 to about 1/(2T) and averages out higher frequencies. Integration mounts a low-noise classical accelerometer on the mirror, records the acceleration a(t) during each shot, integrates it weighted by the sensitivity function to obtain the vibration-induced phase, and subtracts it from the interferometer phase or uses it to choose the fringe readout in real time; this hybrid method relaxes the isolation platform by an order of magnitude and lets the instrument work in the field without a quiet foundation. A timing controller schedules loading, release, the three pulses and detection with microsecond precision and records every analogue signal synchronously so that the state of any shot can be traced afterwards.
units.model: 都市地面加速度雜訊取 1×10⁻⁶ m/s²/√Hz（教學假設），干涉儀有效頻寬約 1/(2T) = 5 Hz：振動相位 ≈ k_eff·T²×10⁻⁶×√5 = 1.611×10⁵×2.24×10⁻⁶ = 0.36 rad，是 10 mrad 目標的 36 倍。混合修正的抑制比 30（受加速度計自雜訊與對準限制）後殘餘 12 mrad ≈ 7.5 µGal，與第 6 單元預算中的 10 µGal 振動項一致。週期時序：裝載 250 ms、冷卻與釋放 30 ms、干涉 2T = 200 ms、偵測 20 ms，合計 0.5 s，即 2 Hz。~Taking urban ground-acceleration noise as 1×10⁻⁶ m/s²/√Hz (teaching assumption) and an effective interferometer bandwidth of about 1/(2T) = 5 Hz, the vibration phase is ≈ k_eff·T²×10⁻⁶×√5 = 1.611×10⁵×2.24×10⁻⁶ = 0.36 rad, 36 times the 10 mrad goal. With a hybrid rejection of 30 (limited by accelerometer self-noise and alignment) the residual is 12 mrad ≈ 7.5 µGal, consistent with the 10 µGal vibration term in the unit-6 budget. Cycle timing: loading 250 ms, cooling and release 30 ms, interferometer 2T = 200 ms, detection 20 ms, total 0.5 s, i.e. 2 Hz.
units.verify: 把古典加速度計的訊號與原子干涉相位逐次對照，畫出散佈圖並擬合斜率，斜率應等於靈敏度函數預測的 k_eff·T² 加權值；開啟混合修正前後各量 1000 次，相位標準差應從數百 mrad 降到 20 mrad 以下；最後把儀器搬到另一地點，重新調垂與對準，確認 2 小時內恢復到規格內的靈敏度。~Compare the classical accelerometer signal with the atom-interferometer phase shot by shot, plot the scatter and fit the slope, which should equal the k_eff·T²-weighted value predicted by the sensitivity function; take 1000 shots before and after enabling the hybrid correction and confirm that the phase standard deviation falls from hundreds of millirad to below 20 mrad; finally move the instrument to another site, re-level and re-align, and confirm that in-specification sensitivity returns within 2 hours.
units.failure: 加速度計與反射鏡之間用了一塊 5 mm 厚的鋁板轉接，板的彎曲共振在 300 Hz，雖在靈敏頻帶之外，但其非線性混頻把 50 Hz 的電源振動搬到 1 Hz 附近，混合修正反而把假訊號注入相位。~Mounting the accelerometer to the mirror through a 5 mm aluminium adapter plate with a 300 Hz bending resonance, outside the sensitive band, lets nonlinear mixing move 50 Hz mains vibration to near 1 Hz, and the hybrid correction injects a false signal into the phase.
units.misconception: 有了古典加速度計混合修正，就完全不需要隔振平台。~With a classical-accelerometer hybrid correction, no isolation platform is needed at all.

units.anchor: 與落體式重力儀比對及 En 值~Comparison with a free-fall gravimeter and En value
units.title: 驗證、國際比對與工程交接~Validation, international comparison and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: 絕對重力儀的驗證方式是與另一台原理不同的絕對儀器在同一點比對：落體式雷射干涉重力儀（如 FG5 型）用角隅稜鏡自由落體與雷射干涉量 g，兩者共享的只有地球本身。比對前要把兩台儀器的參考高度換算到同一點（垂直梯度約 −3 µGal/cm），並施加相同的潮汐、氣壓與極移修正；結果以差值與 En 值表示。國際絕對重力儀比對（ICAG）提供更大規模的驗證。交接文件包含所有偏差表、調垂與波前量測紀錄、頻率參考校正證書、以及每次搬運後的重新驗證程序。~An absolute gravimeter is validated by comparison with an absolute instrument of different principle at the same point: a free-fall laser-interferometer gravimeter (such as the FG5 type) measures g from a falling corner cube and laser interferometry, and the only thing the two share is the Earth itself. Before comparison the reference heights of both instruments are transferred to one point (vertical gradient about −3 µGal/cm) and identical tidal, pressure and polar-motion corrections are applied; the result is reported as a difference with an En value. International comparisons of absolute gravimeters (ICAG) provide validation at larger scale. The handoff file contains every bias table, levelling and wavefront records, the frequency-reference calibration certificate and the re-verification procedure after each transport.
units.model: 原子重力儀讀值 g_A，落體式讀值 g_F，差 1.5 µGal；兩者擴充不確定度各 2 µGal（k = 2）。En = 1.5/√(2² + 2²) = 1.5/2.83 = 0.53 ≤ 1，比對通過。若參考高度差 10 cm 未換算，垂直梯度帶來 30 µGal 的假差異，En 升到 10.6；所以高度換算與梯度量測（以相對重力儀在兩個高度量）是比對的前置條件。~The atom gravimeter reads g_A and the free-fall instrument g_F, differing by 1.5 µGal, each with an expanded uncertainty of 2 µGal (k = 2). En = 1.5/√(2² + 2²) = 1.5/2.83 = 0.53 ≤ 1, so the comparison passes. Had a 10 cm reference-height difference gone uncorrected, the vertical gradient would create a 30 µGal false difference and En would rise to 10.6; height transfer and gradient measurement (with a relative gravimeter at two heights) are therefore prerequisites of any comparison.
units.verify: 在同一基墩上先用相對重力儀量垂直梯度，再讓兩台絕對儀器各連續量測 24 小時以上，套用相同修正模型，計算差值與 En；交接時執行一次完整的「搬運—重設—驗證」演練，記錄從到達到首筆合格數據的時間與每個檢查項目的結果。~On the same pier first measure the vertical gradient with a relative gravimeter, then let both absolute instruments measure continuously for more than 24 hours, apply the same correction model and compute the difference and En; at handoff run a full transport, set-up and verification rehearsal, recording the time from arrival to the first qualifying datum and the result of every checklist item.
units.failure: 兩台儀器用了不同的潮汐模型（一台含海洋負荷、一台不含），在沿海測站造成 5 µGal 的系統差，被解讀為原子重力儀的偏差，導致不必要的拆機重校。~Using different tidal models on the two instruments (one with ocean loading, one without) at a coastal station creates a 5 µGal systematic difference that is read as a bias of the atom gravimeter and triggers an unnecessary teardown and recalibration.
units.misconception: 原子重力儀是量子儀器，所以不需要與傳統重力儀比對。~Being a quantum instrument, an atom gravimeter does not need comparison with classical gravimeters.

example: 銣-87 重力儀設計核對：λ = 780.24 nm，k_eff = 1.611×10⁷ rad/m，T = 100 ms，比例因子 k_eff·T² = 1.611×10⁵ rad/(m/s²)，g = 9.81 m/s² 的干涉相位 1.58×10⁶ rad；都卜勒補償啁啾 α₀ = k_eff·g/(2π) = 25.15 MHz/s，參考振盪器 1×10⁻⁹ 的準確度對應約 1 µGal。靈敏度：每次量測相位雜訊 10 mrad → δg = 6.2 µGal；重複率 2 Hz → 4.4 µGal/√Hz；平均 1000 s → 0.14 µGal。機械：傾斜 50 µrad 的誤差 g·θ²/2 = 1.2 µGal；原子雲水平速度 1 mm/s 的科氏加速度 2Ω_E·v = 14.6 µGal，必須補償。振動：地面雜訊 10⁻⁶ m/s²/√Hz 在 5 Hz 頻寬內給 0.36 rad，混合修正抑制 30 倍後 12 mrad ≈ 7.5 µGal。準確度表合成 1.8 µGal；與落體式重力儀比對差 1.5 µGal、各 2 µGal 不確定度，En = 0.53。所有數值皆為教學假設，不代表任何儀器規格。~Rubidium-87 gravimeter design check: λ = 780.24 nm, k_eff = 1.611×10⁷ rad/m, T = 100 ms, scale factor k_eff·T² = 1.611×10⁵ rad/(m/s²), interferometer phase 1.58×10⁶ rad for g = 9.81 m/s²; Doppler-compensating chirp α₀ = k_eff·g/(2π) = 25.15 MHz/s, and a 1×10⁻⁹ reference-oscillator accuracy corresponds to about 1 µGal. Sensitivity: 10 mrad of phase noise per shot → δg = 6.2 µGal; 2 Hz repetition → 4.4 µGal/√Hz; averaging 1000 s → 0.14 µGal. Mechanics: a 50 µrad tilt gives g·θ²/2 = 1.2 µGal; a 1 mm/s horizontal cloud velocity gives a Coriolis acceleration 2Ω_E·v = 14.6 µGal that must be compensated. Vibration: ground noise of 10⁻⁶ m/s²/√Hz over a 5 Hz bandwidth gives 0.36 rad, reduced 30-fold by hybrid correction to 12 mrad ≈ 7.5 µGal. The accuracy table combines to 1.8 µGal; against a free-fall gravimeter the difference is 1.5 µGal with 2 µGal uncertainties each, En = 0.53. All values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.
history: 1991 年 Kasevich 與朱棣文在史丹佛大學以受激拉曼躍遷實現第一台光脈衝原子干涉儀並量到重力，1999–2001 年 Peters、Chung 與朱棣文把準確度推到約 3 µGal，與落體式重力儀相當。2000 年代起法國 LNE-SYRTE、德國洪堡大學（GAIN）與中國的研究團隊發展可運輸的冷原子重力儀並參與國際絕對重力儀比對；2016–2018 年間源自 SYRTE 的 Muquans（現屬 Exail）推出商用絕對量子重力儀，應用於大地測量、火山與水文監測。本課只重建公開文獻中的原理與工程方法，不涉及任何產品的專有設計。~In 1991 Kasevich and Chu at Stanford University realised the first light-pulse atom interferometer using stimulated Raman transitions and measured gravity with it, and between 1999 and 2001 Peters, Chung and Chu pushed the accuracy to about 3 µGal, on a par with free-fall gravimeters. From the 2000s groups at LNE-SYRTE in France, Humboldt University in Germany (GAIN) and in China developed transportable cold-atom gravimeters and joined international comparisons of absolute gravimeters; between 2016 and 2018 the SYRTE spin-off Muquans (now part of Exail) introduced a commercial absolute quantum gravimeter used in geodesy, volcano and hydrology monitoring. This course reconstructs only principles and engineering methods from public literature, not any product's proprietary design.
